+describe('PERF-15b demo precomputed peaks', () => {
+  const peaksFiles: Record<string, { path: string; decodedLength: number }> = {
+    'demo-middle-east': { path: '/peaks/middle-east.peaks.json', decodedLength: 4469623 },
+    'demo-hero-music': { path: '/peaks/hero-music.peaks.json', decodedLength: 6631424 },
+  };
+
+  it('PS16 peaksUrl names a peaks file only for the two demo MP3 files and returns null for every other source', () => {
+    const peaksUrl = studioLabDemoCollection.peaksUrl;
+    expect(peaksUrl).toBeTypeOf('function');
+    expect(studioLabDemoCollection.sources).toHaveLength(9);
+    for (const source of studioLabDemoCollection.sources) {
+      expect(peaksUrl?.(source), source.id).toBe(peaksFiles[source.id]?.path ?? null);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('PS17 each shipped peaks file parses as 16-bit, fits the size cap and matches the Chromium-decoded length of its MP3 at 44.1 and 48 kHz', () => {
+    for (const [id, { path, decodedLength }] of Object.entries(peaksFiles)) {
+      const text = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../../public', `.${path}`), 'utf8');
+      expect(new TextEncoder().encode(text).byteLength, id).toBeLessThanOrEqual(
+        PRECOMPUTED_PEAKS_MAX_BYTES,
+      );
+      const parsed = parseAudiowaveformPeaks(JSON.parse(text));
+      expect(parsed?.bits, id).toBe(16);
+      const peaks = parsed?.peaks ?? new Float32Array(0);
+      expect(precomputedPeaksMatchDecodedLength(peaks, decodedLength, 44100), id).toBe(true);
+      const at48k = Math.round((decodedLength * 48000) / 44100);
+      expect(precomputedPeaksMatchDecodedLength(peaks, at48k, 48000), id).toBe(true);
+      expect(Math.max(...peaks), id).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
+    }
+  });
+});

     ).resolves.toBeNull();
   });
 });
+
+describe('PP8-PP9 fetchPrecomputedPeaks request policy and refused bodies (PERF-15b)', () => {
+  const body = waveform({ data: [-16384, 0] });
+
+  function trackedBody(cancelled: string[], label: string): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
+    return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
+      start(controller) {
+        controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(body)));
+      },
+      cancel() {
+        cancelled.push(label);
+      },
+    });
+  }
+
+  it('PP8 the peaks request omits credentials, like the audio request', async () => {
+    const fetchPeaks = vi.fn<SourceFetch>(async () => jsonResponse(body));
+    await fetchPrecomputedPeaks('/peaks/a.json', new AbortController().signal, fetchPeaks);
+    expect(fetchPeaks).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(fetchPeaks.mock.calls[0][1].credentials).toBe('omit');
+  });
+
+  it('PP9 a non-ok or over-cap response cancels its unread body; an ok body is read, not cancelled', async () => {
+    const cancelled: string[] = [];
+    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
+    const notFound: SourceFetch = async () =>
+      new Response(trackedBody(cancelled, '404'), { status: 404 });
+    const overCap: SourceFetch = async () =>
+      new Response(trackedBody(cancelled, 'over-cap'), {
+        status: 200,
+        headers: { 'content-length': String(PRECOMPUTED_PEAKS_MAX_BYTES + 1) },
+      });
+    await expect(fetchPrecomputedPeaks('/p', signal, notFound)).resolves.toBeNull();
+    await expect(fetchPrecomputedPeaks('/p', signal, overCap)).resolves.toBeNull();
+    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(cancelled).toEqual(['404', 'over-cap']));
+    const okCancelled: string[] = [];
+    const ok: SourceFetch = async () => {
+      const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
+        start(controller) {
+          controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(body)));
+          controller.close();
+        },
+        cancel() {
+          okCancelled.push('ok');
+        },
+      });
+      return new Response(stream, { status: 200 });
+    };
+    await expect(fetchPrecomputedPeaks('/p', signal, ok)).resolves.not.toBeNull();
+    expect(okCancelled).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
